name: d2-science-steps
note: Science progression as a player hands it out, one objective at a time on the S3 base (2 idle labs, no science automated). Run score: science packs consumed (labs' use), robust to which techs are picked. Checks measure capacity (assemblers not starved) plus delivery, because made/min drops when labs consume less than the block makes.

objectives.name: research-on
objectives.goal: @{agent} our labs are sitting idle. Get research going (oil-processing first, then whatever's cheap and useful) and keep both labs busy.

score.name: researching
score.lua: local c=f.current_research return c and 1 or 0

score.name: labs_working
score.lua: local k=0 for _,l in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{name="lab", force=f}) do if l.status==defines.entity_status.working then k=k+1 end end return k

objectives.name: red-automated
objectives.goal: @{agent} automate red science: at least 15 a minute, made by assemblers and delivered to the labs without hand-feeding.

score.name: red_capacity_per_min
score.lua: local cap=0 for _,a in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{type='assembling-machine', force=f}) do local r=a.get_recipe() if r and r.name=='automation-science-pack' and (a.status==defines.entity_status.working or a.status==defines.entity_status.full_output) then cap=cap+60*a.crafting_speed/r.energy end end return cap
score.note: packs/min the red assemblers can make: those working or backed up (not starved)

score.name: labs_working
score.lua: local k=0 for _,l in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{name='lab', force=f}) do if l.status==defines.entity_status.working then k=k+1 end end return k

objectives.name: green-automated
objectives.goal: @{agent} now green science the same way: at least 10 a minute into the labs, automated.

score.name: green_capacity_per_min
score.lua: local cap=0 for _,a in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{type='assembling-machine', force=f}) do local r=a.get_recipe() if r and r.name=='logistic-science-pack' and (a.status==defines.entity_status.working or a.status==defines.entity_status.full_output) then cap=cap+60*a.crafting_speed/r.energy end end return cap

objectives.name: six-labs
objectives.goal: @{agent} research is too slow. Get us to 6 labs, all working.

score.name: labs_working
score.lua: local k=0 for _,l in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{name="lab", force=f}) do if l.status==defines.entity_status.working then k=k+1 end end return k

score.name: science_packs_used
score.note: lifetime packs consumed by labs; progress = value - baseline

score.name: techs_researched
score.lua: local k=0 for _,t in pairs(f.technologies) do if t.researched then k=k+1 end end return k
